coverage_gap=The value of hd->buffer_size_max passed to gb_hd_create in drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c was not re-read, so the exact over-read extent (intra-object vs past-struct heap OOB) of the gb-beagleplay.c:213 finding is not pinned down.
coverage_gap=HCI-side (host-controller-driver) setters of urb->actual_length (ehci-q.c, ehci-sched.c, c67x00, isp116x/isp1362, max3421, dummy_hcd) were inspected only via grep hits, not per-site, so a controller double-count bug feeding actual_length > transfer_buffer_length cannot be excluded from this pass.
coverage_gap=drivers/usb/storage/transport.c us->current_urb->actual_length consumers and drivers/staging/gpib bulk_urb->actual_length consumers were identified but not deep-read; they are sync-URB style paths where the same HCD bound applies.
